name: MARVIS_ZERO_COST_V1
objective: Measure whether legally reusable zero-cost features add out-of-sample probability and decision value without changing production rules.

dataset_policy.split: rolling-origin temporal validation by league and season
dataset_policy.variant_e_comparison: paired fixtures only to avoid coverage-selection bias

metrics: calibration curve and expected calibration error
out-of-sample ROI only where retained historical odds rights and coverage are valid
decision_rules: Do not claim value from in-sample accuracy.
Compare each variant against A on identical out-of-sample fixtures.
Report bootstrap confidence intervals and league dispersion.
ROI is unavailable when contemporaneous odds are unavailable.
No experiment result changes production without a separate approval task.
reason: Goals/form/xG/shots models are empirically testable at zero incremental data cost, but the repository currently lacks a validated, settled, rights-cleared OOS dataset sufficient to claim positive ROI.
